A serial CO₂ sensor, a chip, and nothing else

Two WebAssembly modules in one tab. The emulator runs real ESP32-C3 firmware that reads an MH-Z19B with the stock uart driver on UART1. mhz19b.wasm, built from examples/parts/mhz19b, hears the chip on GPIO 4 and answers on GPIO 5. Change the air and the next reading follows.

Pick the two files this page runs. The firmware is test_apps/uart_mhz19b built for esp32c3 (its merged flash image). The part is mhz19b.wasm, built from examples/parts/mhz19b.
